title: Gestalt
description: Use Gestalt-inspired hacks to stay present and aware, resolving inner conflicts.

entries.title: Notice Where in Your Body You Feel Stress, Joy, or Any Other Emotion
Pause, Take a Deep Breath, and Ask Yourself, ‘what Am I Feeling Right Now
Think of Any Old Grudges, Unresolved Issues, or Unsaid Things
Try Doing Something Differently Than You Usually Would
Use the App to Log Meaningful Events or Decisions as They Happen
When You Feel Something Intense, Say ‘I Feel [emotion] Because of [situation]

trust_boundary.reason: The inherited experiential exercises are therapy-branded and source-free. Their current wording is not suitable for automatic self-help recommendation without a narrower evidence and safety boundary.
trust_boundary.next_action: Identify a concrete low-risk awareness exercise with a directly matching authoritative or peer-reviewed source, or keep the collection archive-only.
trust_boundary.scope_note: This status describes Brali's current corpus, source matching, and editorial review state. It is not a scientific verdict about the efficacy or evidence base of the underlying therapy, school, or professional tradition.
